titre: Exercices — Present perfect avec since et for
consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec for ou since : I have known Tom ___ 2018.
Complète avec for ou since : She has been ill ___ a week.
exercices.reponse: She has been ill for a week.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : They (to live) in London for ten years.
exercices.reponse: They have lived in London for ten years.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : He (to know) her since primary school.
corrige: Participe passé irrégulier de « know » = known.
exercices.reponse: He has known her since primary school.

exercices.enonce: Mets le verbe au present perfect : I (to be) a member since January.
exercices.reponse: I have been a member since January.

exercices.enonce: Mets à la forme négative : She has seen him since Monday.
corrige: Négation à la 3e personne : has + not = hasn't.
On garde le participe passé « seen ».
exercices.reponse: She hasn't seen him since Monday.

exercices.enonce: Transforme en question avec How long : You have studied Spanish.
corrige: Question de durée : How long + have + sujet + participe passé.
exercices.reponse: How long have you studied Spanish?

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Je travaille ici depuis trois mois. »
corrige: « three months » est une durée → for.
exercices.reponse: I have worked here for three months.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Nous n'avons pas mangé depuis midi. »
corrige: Present perfect négatif : haven't + participe passé.
« midday » est un point de départ → since.

exercices.enonce: Corrige la phrase : « I have lived here since five years. »
corrige: « five years » est une durée, pas un point de départ.
exercices.reponse: I have lived here for five years.
